title: Add Dummy Node
description: Create a new dummy node q and add zero-weight edges from q to every other node in the graph. This ensures all nodes are reachable for the Bellman-Ford initialization step.

title: Run Bellman-Ford from Dummy Node
description: Execute Bellman-Ford algorithm from q to compute the shortest distance h(v) = dist(q, v) for all nodes. If a negative cycle is detected, terminate the algorithm as shortest paths are undefined.

title: Reweight All Edges
description: For each edge (u,v) with original weight w(u,v), compute a new weight: w'(u,v) = w(u,v) + h(u) - h(v). This transformation makes all edge weights non-negative while preserving shortest path ordering.

title: Remove Dummy Node
description: Remove the dummy node q and its incident edges from the graph. The remaining graph has all non-negative edge weights.

title: Run Dijkstra from Each Node
description: Execute Dijkstra's algorithm from each node in the reweighted graph to compute all-pairs shortest paths using the transformed edge weights.

title: Transform Distances Back
description: For each computed distance dist'(u,v) in the reweighted graph, recover the original distance: dist(u,v) = dist'(u,v) - h(u) + h(v).
